label: skirts-dresses-ref (reference for tiered/buttoned/frilly skirts and sailor/pinafore/belted/princess dresses)
hair-styles-ref (reference for long, ponytail, bob, braid hair)
long-hair-edit (rookie-idle edited to long hair; the long hair layers are taken from it)
ponytail-edit (rookie-idle edited to a ponytail, drawn 2 px to the right; the ponytail layers are taken from it)
braid-edit (rookie-idle edited to a braid; the braid layers are taken from it)
bob-edit (rookie-idle edited to a bob, 66 wide, drawn 1 px to the right; the bob layers are taken from it)
curly-edit (rookie-idle edited to curly hair, 67 wide, drawn 1 px to the right; the curly layers are taken from it)
